How do these technologies work together?

Modern AI systems rarely rely on a single technology. A self-driving car uses computer vision to see, machine learning to make decisions, and natural language processing to communicate with passengers. Generative AI combines neural networks, attention mechanisms, and massive datasets to create content. The magic happens when these technologies converge.
